sources.title: Causality != Invariance: Function and Concept Vectors in LLMs
sources.supported: The paper separates causally effective function vectors from input-format-invariant concept representations.
sources.limit: It concerns selected attention-head representations;we do not reproduce its RSA selection,extract vectors or claim its method applies unchanged to native MLP channels.
